aria-invalid.zh-CN: 是否校验失败，设置在根元素的 `aria-invalid` 上。
aria-invalid.en-US: Whether validation failed, set as `aria-invalid` on the root element.

aria-required.zh-CN: 是否必填，设置在根元素的 `aria-required` 上。
aria-required.en-US: Whether a value is required, set as `aria-required` on the root element.

allowClear.zh-CN: 是否允许再次点击已选中的星后清除数值。
allowClear.en-US: Whether clicking the selected star again clears the value.

allowHalf.en-US: Whether half stars can be selected.

autoFocus.zh-CN: 挂载时自动获取焦点，落点与 `ref` 的 `focus()` 相同。
autoFocus.en-US: Focuses the rating on mount, on the same radio that `focus()` picks.

character.zh-CN: 每颗星中绘制的字符，可传入 React 节点，如 `<IconLikeHeart />`，未设置时为星形图标。传入纯文本字符串时，该文本作为各星可访问名称与整组摘要的单位。
character.en-US: Character drawn in every star, a React node such as `<IconLikeHeart />`; the star icon when not set. When it is a plain text string, that text is the unit in each star's accessible name and the group summary.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

disabled.zh-CN: 只读，无法进行交互，也无法获得焦点。
disabled.en-US: Read-only: no interaction and no focus.

onBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开整个评分组件时的回调，在星之间移动不触发。
onBlur.en-US: Called when focus leaves the whole rating; moving between stars does not call it.

onChange.zh-CN: 选择变化时的回调，参数为新的值。
onChange.en-US: Called when the selection changes, with the new value.

onClick.zh-CN: 点击星或按 Enter、Space 选中时的回调，参数为事件与星的序号；不会作为根元素的原生 click 监听。
onClick.en-US: Called when a star is clicked or selected with Enter or Space, with the event and the star index. It is not a native click listener on the root element.

onFocus.zh-CN: 焦点进入整个评分组件时的回调，在星之间移动不触发。
onFocus.en-US: Called when focus enters the whole rating; moving between stars does not call it.

onHoverChange.zh-CN: 指针经过时数值变化的回调；指针移出或点击清除时参数为 `undefined`。
onHoverChange.en-US: Called when the hovered value changes; receives `undefined` when the pointer leaves or a click clears the value.

onKeyDown.zh-CN: 方向键使值移动时的回调，其他按键不触发。
onKeyDown.en-US: Called for an arrow key that moves the value; other keys do not call it.

prefixCls.en-US: Class name prefix of the component.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 聚焦组件内的星（包括 `autoFocus` 与 `focus()`）时，是否阻止浏览器滚动文档以显示新聚焦的星。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether to keep the browser from scrolling the document to show a star focused inside the component, including focus from `autoFocus` and `focus()`.

ref.zh-CN: 组件句柄，暴露 `focus()` 与 `blur()` 方法。
ref.en-US: Handle of the component, exposing the `focus()` and `blur()` methods.

size.zh-CN: 尺寸，可选 `default`、`small`，也可传入 number 自定义尺寸。
size.en-US: Size: `default` or `small`, or a number for a custom size.

tooltips.zh-CN: 每颗星的提示信息，数组下标与星的序号对应；空字符串或缺省的项不显示提示。
tooltips.en-US: Tooltip text for each star, matched by array index to the star position; an empty or missing item shows no tooltip.

value.zh-CN: 当前受控值，传入后由该值决定显示；变回 `undefined` 时回到 `defaultValue` 并转为非受控。
value.en-US: Controlled value. When given, this value decides what is shown; back to `undefined` it returns to `defaultValue` and becomes uncontrolled.

focus.zh-CN: 聚焦 Tab 会到达的 radio，与 `autoFocus` 的落点相同；禁用时无效。
focus.en-US: Focuses the radio that Tab reaches, the same one `autoFocus` picks. Does nothing when disabled.

blur.zh-CN: 焦点位于评分内时移除焦点；禁用时无效。
blur.en-US: Removes focus when it is inside the rating. Does nothing when disabled.
